metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Hand Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises that may help quickly relieve hand pain — even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

These exercises are beneficial for everything from minor aches and pains to more serious conditions like arthritis in the hands and fingers.

Each exercise targets hand pain differently. For the best results, try them all and continue with the ones that provide the most relief.
